dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast 'O'-shaped rings with sharply defined light perimeters and dark centers; perimeter gradients transition abruptly from light pixels to the dark background pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of irregular high-intensity pixel clusters situated between the macro-annuli and in the anterior dorsal section, lacking a defined internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle in the mid-lateral field; a separate linear chain of four smaller centroids is visible superior to this triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A vertical high-intensity white artifact is present at the posterior-most edge; a localized green-yellow chromatic shift is visible on the anterior-ventral curve.
